note: Luminos polish: cranked up to 12px and reduced from three sprites to two (gold and lavender). New toolbar button toggles ambient sparks on or off and persists in fl_tg_luminos. Color picker stall fix: sprites get will-change for compositor offload plus a body class that pauses animation while any context menu or color input is interacting. Safety timer unpauses every six seconds so a missed event never leaves the layer stuck. Tooltip consistency: registered tgTopLeft positioner at script init so both the price chart and the compose chart pin the tooltip to the top-left corner with the same mode index intersect false setup.
